capacity:uploads.title: Image uploads can't keep up
capacity:uploads.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 80/s and handles 16/s (500%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:uploads.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.
